== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Evacuate? (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 7.3), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Evacuate? (V)]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Use 1 Force to traget your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. USED: During any move phase, take target into hand. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L6286</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_245</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
